title: CUT&RUN Library Prep with NEBNext Ultra II
author: Nan Liu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bagaibse
materials: NEBNext Ultra II DNA Library Prep Kit

steps.title: End Repair
steps.instruction: Prepare the End Prep reaction in a sterile nuclease-free tube and incubate in a thermocycler.

substeps.instruction: Add 55.5 μl Fragmented DNA (<30 ng fragmented DNA), 3.0 μl End Prep Enzyme Mix, and 6.5 μl End Repair Reaction Buffer (10x).
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down at least 10 times using a 100 or 200 μl pipette set to 25 μl.
Perform a quick spin to collect liquid.
Incubate in a thermocycler with the heated lid set to ≥ 60°C using the following program: 20°C for 30 minutes, 65°C for 30 minutes, and hold at 4°C.

steps.title: Adaptor Dilution
steps.instruction: Dilute the Adaptor based on the amount of input DNA.

substeps.instruction: For 6 ng input DNA (0.2 pmol), dilute the original 15 μM adaptor to 3 μM.
Use approximately 4 pmol (1.25 μL of 3 μM adaptor), which is 20-fold of the DNA fragment. To reduce PCR dimers, use as low as 0.6 pmol (3x) for 0.2 pmol input DNA.

steps.title: Adaptor Ligation
steps.instruction: Perform the ligation reaction by adding components to the End Prep Reaction Mixture.

substeps.instruction: Add 15 μl Blunt/TA Ligase Master Mix, 1 μl Ligation Enhancer, and 2.5 μl NEBNext Adaptor For Illumina (from NEB #E7350, #E7335, #E7500, #E7710, #E7730, #E6609, or #E7600).
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down at least 10 times using a 100 or 200 μl pipette set to 40 μl.
Perform a quick spin to collect liquid.
Incubate at 20°C for 15 minutes in a thermal cycler.

steps.title: USER Enzyme Treatment
steps.instruction: Treat the ligation mixture with USER enzyme.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5 μl of USER™ enzyme (NEB# M5505) to the ligation mixture.
Mix well and incubate at 37°C for 15 minutes with the heated lid set to ≥ 47°C.

steps.title: First DNA Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the short DNA using AMPure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex AMPure XP beads to resuspend and warm to room temperature for at least 30 minutes.
Add 80 μl (~1.75x) AMPure XP beads to the ligation reaction.
Mix well by pipetting up and down at least 10 times or vortex for 3-5 seconds on high.
Incubate on bench top for at least 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place on a magnetic stand for 5 minutes until the solution is clear.
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Add 200 μl of 80% freshly prepared ethanol while on the magnetic stand, incubate for 30 seconds, and discard the supernatant.
Repeat the ethanol wash once more, removing all visible liquid.
Air dry the beads for up to 5 minutes on the magnetic stand with the lid open (do not overdry).
Remove from magnetic stand and elute DNA into 15 μl of 10 mM Tris-HCl or 0.1X TE.
Mix well and incubate for at least 2 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnetic stand for 5 minutes, then transfer 13 μl to a new PCR tube.
Optional: Store samples at -20°C.

steps.title: Library Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the ligated fragments via PCR.

substeps.instruction: Mix the following in sterile strip tubes (Total volume 30 μl): 15 μl Adaptor Ligated Fragments, 25 μl NEBNext Q5 Hot Start HiFi PCR Master Mix, 5 μl Index Primer/I7 primer, and 5 μl Universal PCR primer/I5 Primer (from NEB #E7350, #E7335, #E7500, #E7710, #E7730, #E6609, or #E7600).
Run PCR with the following conditions: 98°C for 30 seconds (1 cycle); 98°C for 10 seconds, 65°C for 75 seconds (4-12 cycles); 65°C for 5 minutes (1 cycle); hold at 4°C.

steps.title: First Round Size Selection
steps.instruction: Remove PCR products larger than 350 bp.

substeps.instruction: Vortex and warm AMPure XP beads to room temperature for 30 minutes.
Add 24 μl (0.8X) resuspended AMPure XP beads to the PCR reaction.
Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times and incubate for at least 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place on a magnetic stand for 5 minutes (or until clear).
Carefully transfer the supernatant (containing DNA) to a new tube and discard the beads.

steps.title: Second Round Size Selection
steps.instruction: Remove PCR products shorter than 150 bp.

substeps.instruction: Add 12 μl (final 1.2x) resuspended AMPure XP beads to the supernatant from the previous step.
Mix at least 10 times and incubate on the bench top for at least 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place on a magnetic stand for 5 minutes to separate beads from supernatant.
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 200 μl of 80% freshly prepared ethanol (30 seconds incubation per wash).
Air dry the beads for up to 5 minutes on the magnetic stand (elute when beads are dark brown and glossy, not cracked).
Remove from magnetic stand and elute DNA by adding 15 μl of 0.1X TE.
Mix well and incubate for at least 2 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnetic stand for 5 minutes, then transfer 13 μl to a new PCR tube and store at -20°C.

steps.title: Quality Control and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Verify library size and proceed to sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Check size distribution on an Agilent Bioanalyzer® High Sensitivity DNA chip or TAPESTATION (expected size: 160-350 bp).
If dimers (128 bp) are present, perform another 1.2X AMPure XP cleanup or gel-based size selection (2-3% agarose gel or Pippin Prep).
Perform pair-end sequencing.
Trim read-through adaptors from reads shorter than the sequencing length (e.g., 42 bp).
